summary: This bill amends federal law to allow qualified active-duty members of the Armed Forces to carry concealed firearms nationwide, similar to the existing provisions for qualified law enforcement officers, by requiring them to carry military identification and proof of recent firearms qualification.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly expands the right to carry concealed firearms nationwide for qualified members of the Armed Forces, directly protecting and expanding gun rights. This is the central purpose of the bill.

The bill specifically addresses members of the Armed Forces by granting them nationwide concealed carry reciprocity. While it doesn't directly impact military spending or defense policy, it grants a significant right to military personnel, making it moderately relevant.
